text:
jamie (eng-platform): Quick question — I pushed updated end-to-end bench data for the EU Dedicated pool. 30B quantized model, H100 vs A100, p99 and throughput charts attached in the doc. Can we pick concurrency targets for steady-state and headroom for autoscaling?

mike (eng-ml): Got them, skimmed. H100 p50 ~18ms, p99 ~120ms at 8 concurrent on 80-token average. A100 looks ~1.6x slower tail.

priya (eng-platform): Important: those numbers are from a single-region run with cold cache. We should account for KV cache warm vs cold; warm improves p99 by ~20-30% in prior sims.

jamie (eng-platform): Good point. Ops, any recommended safety margin for Dedicated SLA (p95 < 100ms target we set)?

opsbot: Reminder: SLA p95 target = 100ms for premium tier. Autoscaler min/max pool sizes: min=4 GPUs, max=40 GPUs per region by default.

priya (eng-platform): For H100, hitting p95<100ms maps to ~6-7 concurrency per GPU for the 30B quantized profile with warm cache. Set steady-state target concurrency=6, surge target=10 for short bursts?

mike (eng-ml): I agree for EU. For A100, concurrency should be lower — 4 steady-state, surge 7. Kernel selection matters: FP16-optimized kernel gives better throughput on H100; on A100 the int8-quant path reduces tail but increases CPU side prep time.

jamie (eng-platform): How much autoscale headroom to keep queued requests low but not overprovision? Sim I ran suggests a 25% headroom (i.e., trigger scale-up at 75% util measured at p95 budget) keeps p99s under control during 30-min spikes.

priya (eng-platform): 25% sounds reasonable. Need to cap burst-to-dedicated ratio to avoid runaway costs; propose autoscale policy: scale-up threshold at 72% util over 60s, scale-down after 300s below 40%, max-burst-to-dedicated ratio=1.5.

mike (eng-ml): Add region-specific adjustments: APAC latency higher for EU-hosted pools. For APAC Dedicated pool, use lower concurrency (H100 steady 5) and higher headroom (30%) because tail variance is larger in our APAC tests.

sara (eng-sre): Also factor in rollout safety: when we change kernel variants or quant config, we should canary 10% of capacity with new config and monitor p95/p99 for 60m before full rollout. If p99 regresses >15% revert automatically.

jamie (eng-platform): Can we codify this into a concise config snippet for the pool? e.g.:

```
pool_config:
  gpu_type: H100
  steady_concurrency: 6
  surge_concurrency: 10
  autoscale:
    scale_up_threshold: 0.72
    scale_up_window_s: 60
    scale_down_threshold: 0.40
    scale_down_window_s: 300
    max_burst_ratio: 1.5
  canary_fraction: 0.10
  canary_monitor_window_m: 60
  p99_revert_pct: 15
```

priya (eng-platform): That looks good — small tweaks per region (APAC: steady_concurrency:5, headroom 0.7 trigger).

mike (eng-ml): One more: include kernel hint field so runtime picks FP16 path on H100 by default and int8 path on A100 when quantized model available. Otherwise operator error will pick suboptimal kernels.

jamie (eng-platform): I'll update the planning doc with these numbers and send a short PR to the autoscaler policy repo. Can someone volunteer to run a full sim across EU/US/APAC with 7-day spike traces?

mike (eng-ml): I can run the sim with the new config, will post results tomorrow AM.

priya (eng-platform): I can wire the canary policy into the rollout job once sim looks sane.

sara (eng-sre): I'll add an alert playbook: if canary p99 > baseline*1.15 alert to #oncall and auto-revert set.

jamie (eng-platform): Awesome. Thanks all — let's reconvene after the sim. :thumbsup:
